sql:
SELECT
    dc.ChannelName,
    sum(fs.SalesAmount)                                  AS TotalSalesAmount,
    count(*)                                             AS TotalTransactions,
    sum(fs.SalesAmount) / nullif(count(*), 0)            AS AvgTransactionValue
FROM retail.FactSales fs
JOIN retail.DimChannel dc ON fs.channelKey = dc.ChannelKey
WHERE dc.ChannelName IN ('Store', 'Online')
GROUP BY dc.ChannelName
ORDER BY AvgTransactionValue DESC
